property_summary: For any block number that is a multiple of 15, a valid 10-ether fallback call must drain the contract so its balance is 0; the mutant only pays when the block is a multiple of 16, so it retains funds on blocks like 15 that are multiples of 15 but not 16.
change_summary: Replace the modulo divisor 15 with 16 so payouts occur on different block numbers.
